scope: Four independently installable wheels and one exact-version collection

components.purpose: Compare valid public intake mapping declarations and retain descriptive changes.
components.use_case: Explain a changed source header, conversion type or required flag before a separate intake decision.
components.establishes: Compare valid public intake mapping declarations and retain descriptive changes.
does_not_establish: Verified rename or applied mapping change

components.purpose: Plan manual-review or skip decisions from explicit batch and receipt snapshots without replay authorization.
components.use_case: Review a selected batch with no receipt while skipping an exact declared committed match.
components.establishes: Plan manual-review or skip decisions from explicit batch and receipt snapshots without replay authorization.
does_not_establish: Complete actual history or verified commit

components.purpose: Check an ordinal checkpoint proposal against contiguous declared committed batch coverage.
components.use_case: Find a gap before reviewing a proposed progress marker of two.
components.establishes: Check an ordinal checkpoint proposal against contiguous declared committed batch coverage.
does_not_establish: Verified previous checkpoint or source watermark
Actual target commit or authorized advancement

components.purpose: Reconcile an explicit expected batch cohort with matching declared committed receipts and totals.
components.use_case: Account for selected declared batch counts without treating omitted receipts as completed work.
components.establishes: Reconcile an explicit expected batch cohort with matching declared committed receipts and totals.
does_not_establish: Source count recomputation or receipt authenticity
Actual store contents or completeness outside the selected cohort

collection.dependency_rule: Install all five reviewed wheels from one directory; exact-version dependencies resolve offline.

related_systems.adapter_status: not implemented; caller-reviewed mapping/type/normalization, batch/attempt identity, hash-domain, count, commit-evidence and progress mappings are required
